name: Sydney
about: Southern Hemisphere summer (Dec–Feb) is beach season and peak crowds/prices; autumn (Mar–May) offers warm days with far fewer people.
overview: Harbor beaches, an unmistakable opera house, and an outdoor culture built around ferries, coffee, and the water.
costOverview: A coffee, a pie, or the ferry won't dent the budget; taxis and paid attractions are where Sydney gets expensive.
